why: An arrival's reaction window moves the keyboard guard's arrival that far forward (issue #919): a match's outcome opens on the frame the match ends, and a Space laid as a mine a moment later was pressed for the match. Ignored, that press activates Next Level, Retry or Rematch before the player has seen the result.
killedBy: createCarriedConfirmGuard (issue #919) extends an arrival by its reaction window, so a press begun inside it is cancelled too
hud: arrival lands on the primary action, and a Confirm from the screen before cannot press it (issue #919) a Space pressed in the moment a match is lost cannot press the outcome, and one after can
hud: arrival lands on the primary action, and a Confirm from the screen before cannot press it (issue #919) an Enter pressed in the moment a match is won cannot press the outcome, and one after can
